#nigeria #biafra #history #shorts

lines.text: Nigeria's civil war lasted two and a half years. And it began with one declaration.
In 1966, two military coups and deadly violence against Igbo people in the North drove many back to the East.
On May thirtieth, 1967, Lieutenant Colonel Ojukwu declared the Eastern Region independent, as the Republic of Biafra.
The federal government, led by General Yakubu Gowon, went to war to keep Nigeria one.
A blockade cut Biafra off. Historians estimate between half a million and three million people died, most of them from hunger.
In January 1970, Biafra surrendered, and Gowon declared: no victor, no vanquished.
